# Rijul Soni — Software Engineer

Rijul Soni is a backend-focused software engineer working on quick-commerce, delivery, and marketplace platforms. He writes Node.js + MySQL backend code, builds Next.js/React frontends, and integrates payment gateways (tokenized cards, recurring charges).

## Currently
Software Engineer at Jungleworks (since June 2025), Mohali, Punjab. Engineering core modules for Yelo, a SaaS multi-vendor marketplace powering e-commerce, food, and hyperlocal delivery.

## Key facts
- Cut delivery-assignment latency by 35% via Node.js API improvements and MySQL query optimization.
- Implemented geofencing, location-based filtering, and real-time inventory synchronization for hyperlocal serviceability.
- Integrated multiple payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe, Worldpay Access) and Tookan for automated delivery tracking.
- Tokenized card payments with recurring (MIT/CIT) flows — Worldpay schemeTransactionReference reuse for continued MIT billing; PCI-safe handling.
- Previously: Associate Software Engineer at Watermark Insights (Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, React, Redux, Docker, RSpec, Jest).
